blind.description: A small metallic goblet or chalice featuring a rounded open cup, a short turned stem with a central knop, and a flared circular foot. The surface is smooth, solid, and finished in a uniform polished pewter or grey metal material, resting stably directly on the floor with no defects or floating parts.
blind.from_above: A circular dark opening framed by a concentric metallic rim, casting a rounded shadow to the upper-left.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1/10 to 1/12 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 6 to 7 inches tall).
